statements.text: Impression: right-sided lumbar radiculopathy secondary to L5-S1 disc herniation causing foraminal stenosis.
MRI lumbar spine 08/22/2026: L5-S1 disc herniation with moderate right foraminal stenosis contacting the exiting nerve root.
Function: unable to stand long enough to cook a meal, has stopped driving because of the pain.
Baseline NRS prior to any intervention: 7/10.
Symptoms began on 04/07/2026, 24 weeks before this visit.
Completed physical therapy from 04/18/2026 to 06/06/2026 (7 weeks) with no lasting benefit, and failed naproxen 500 mg BID.
Continues the daily home exercise program taught in PT.
Denies fever, chills, weight loss, or bowel or bladder changes; no history of cancer.
